quality: Coherent stylized candidate, consistent across desktop/mobile closed/open captures; full silhouette and controls fit. Marketing has richer lighting, surface detail and grounding, not a demonstrated missing-part or rendering defect.
hardware: Brass corner caps, central clasp/disc, side ring and pale feet preserve the reference arrangement. Runtime brass is flatter and simpler. Open captures show two rear hinges and the raised latch tongue; small attachment details and stepped rim joints are visually under-resolved, not proven disconnected or colliding.
terrain: Connected mint-green multi-peak relief with rounded canopy and pale rock accents retains the reference composition. Runtime rock/forest separation is weaker and more granular. Terrain faces away in front-open views; no disappearance is established.
texture: Pale diagonal stone banding can read as marble; greens read teal/mint, canopy is rounded and simplified. Exact marketing has more granular teal surfaces, brass variation and contact shading.
limitations: Read source README. Static front-angle review only; no continuous collision, hidden attachment, physical-phone performance or user approval certification. Marketing finish equivalence is not claimed. Simplified interior, stylized terrain apron and low-resolution details remain.
decision: Pass as a disclosed stylized review candidate, not approval or a photoreal marketing match. No blocking visual defect established in the inspected images.

quality: Recognizable bamboo/karst study with consistent desktop/mobile states and complete framing. Promotional relief, material irregularity and grounding are stronger; these are finish gaps rather than demonstrated functional defects.
hardware: Front clasp/disc, side ring, brass lid corners, dark framing and pale stone feet retain the broad reference arrangement. Actual fittings are blockier; marketing edging has more stitch-like detail. Open hinges and raised latch tongue are visible, but mounting and rim junctions are not mechanically verifiable from stills.
terrain: Three uneven pale faceted peaks, green vegetation patches and winding jade inlay remain readable. Runtime peaks are chalkier and more angular, bases abrupt, river flat; open front views naturally conceal the ornamented lid exterior.
texture: Honey weave is regular and tile/brick-like versus the reference's more irregular relief. Dark bindings and green stacked seam are conspicuous. Interior repeats the weave and has less shaded depth than the marketing exterior.
limitations: Read source README: no supplied Laos marketing illustration existed during original authoring, so this is a current comparison, not evidence of a failed original image-match contract. Stylized procedural bamboo, generic karst and thin river inlay are disclosed. Green seam and apparent open attachment gaps are not proven faults. Still review does not certify motion, hidden geometry or physical-phone performance.
decision: Pass as a disclosed stylized candidate. Preserve the weave/terrain/finish caveats; no blocking visual defect established and no user approval implied.

quality: Consistent, fully framed pale landscape chest in all four original captures. The exact marketing reference is itself stylized and stepped; runtime simplification should not be mistaken for loss of a photoreal reference terrain.
hardware: Central clasp/disc, side ring, corner caps and pale block feet match the broad reference layout. Runtime brass is flatter with less mounting definition. Open views expose two rear hinges, latch tongue, green rim and pale corner blocks; visible step joints and hinge gaps do not establish broken attachment.
terrain: Two terraced outcrops, narrow turquoise channel and sparse green sprigs preserve the reference arrangement. Runtime outcrops read as stacked cut slabs, fern identity is weak especially on mobile, and ravine depth is only partly legible. Terrain is naturally hidden in front-open views.
texture: Pale horizontal procedural banding reads as wood grain rather than convincing sandstone; this wood-like reading also occurs in marketing. Runtime material variation, foliage clarity and contact shadows are weaker. Water remains a flat narrow inlay.
limitations: Read source README: stepped rock, wood-like banding, weak small-scale ferns and limited ravine visibility are disclosed v1 limitations, not failed technical gates. Screenshots cannot prove continuous mechanical clearance, hidden joints, physical-device performance or exact material parity.
decision: Pass as a disclosed stylized candidate, with fern and sandstone readability caveats. No blocking visible geometry or cross-device mismatch established; not user approval or marketing-equivalence certification.

quality: Recognizable Richat-inspired chest, consistently rendered and unclipped across desktop/mobile closed/open originals. Marketing has deeper channel shading, stronger metal highlights and studio grounding; no major missing geometry is evident.
hardware: Brass central clasp/disc and lid corner fittings, slate seam and chunky gray feet preserve reference identity. Runtime hardware is simplified and its mounts understated. Open hinges and raised latch tongue are visible; dark rear gap and stepped rim joins warrant no unsupported claim of physical disconnection.
terrain: Jagged concentric ridge relief with pale slopes and slate-colored crests remains on the closed lid. At mobile scale the rings are less readable and can look crown-like. Marketing also uses angular serrated relief, but has stronger channel separation. Front-open views conceal exterior terrain as expected.
texture: Prominent repetitive cream/ochre waves read as wood grain or stylized bedding on exterior and interior; the reference also has wavy wood-like banding. Runtime repetition is more conspicuous and lighting less nuanced.
limitations: Read source README: exaggerated serrated rings, wood-like bedding, conspicuous dark blocks and understated hardware mounts are disclosed. Not measured geology or photoreal reconstruction. Static front views cannot establish full mechanism integrity, hidden floor condition, continuous collision or physical-phone performance.
decision: Pass as a disclosed stylized candidate. Retain terrain-readability and repeated-banding caveats; no blocking visual defect established, no user approval implied.

quality: Partial, explicitly unapproved v6 candidate; retain archive hold. Fully framed consistent desktop/mobile states do not resolve reference-finish gaps. Exact marketing has pale cream/gold body bands; runtime has stronger rose/rust/cream bands. This is a reference difference, not evidence of a new v6 preservation failure.
hardware: Brass clasp/disc, low front ring and lower corner guards retain broad reference placement, but runtime fittings are crowded/blockier and less integrated. Open rear hinges and raised latch tongue are visible; stills do not prove faulty attachment. README identifies hardware differences as pre-existing and intentionally untouched.
terrain: Pink jagged Atlas ridge remains visible on both closed captures; runtime silhouette and striations are coarse. Ridge/reference differences were intentionally outside v6 changes. It faces away in open captures; no missing terrain is established.
texture: Exact reference has a dense green/white high-contrast ceramic border and restrained dark lid sides. V6 border reads pale/open with weak dark contrast and unresolved angular/corner detail, especially on mobile. Vertical cedar grain is warmer/coarser and stronger than the unchanged central top. Body banding is much rosier than marketing; README says original v5 payloads/UVs were retained with restrained darkening. Dark open interior limits grain/floor inspection.
limitations: Read source README: the single permitted integrated correction was used; continuous ceramic panels fixed fragmented relief, not final motif equivalence. V6 is partial, not new user approval. Marketing/body/ridge/hardware differences must not be relabeled as new proven v6 regressions. Static images do not certify mechanical operation or physical-phone performance.
decision: Needs explicit decision on the remaining ceramic contrast/interlocking/corners and lid-edge grain before any promotion. Preserve unapproved v6/archive hold; no art edits or further iterations authorized by this review.
